    dist = [None]*N
    dist[p] = 0
    par = [0]*N
    par[p] = -1
    stack = [p]
    order = []
    visited = set([p])
    ast = stack.append
    apo = order.append
    while stack:

        apo(vn)

            if vf in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(vf)
            par[vf] = vn
            dist[vf] = 1+dist[vn]
            ast(vf)
    return par, order, dist
